description: The E-Cartier is part of a new wave of hard-working, fun-loving bikes. Whether you're getting around the city, commuting, or trying to take the bike instead of the car. The powerful Shimano Steps motor and straight handlebars deliver a sporty ride and reliable power. The fully integrated design means that all the key accessories, like a digital display, rack, fenders, lights, and stand, come standard – all without looking or feeling clunky. No matter where you’re headed, the E-Cartier will boost your ride.
